problem.explanation: IS NULL performs the special missing-value check SQL requires. ORDER BY id makes output deterministic. A common mistake is email = NULL, which evaluates to unknown and matches nothing. COALESCE is useful when missing values should be displayed rather than filtered.
hints: NULL is not equal to any value, including NULL.
Use IS NULL rather than = NULL.
problem.reference_solution: SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE email IS NULL ORDER BY id
problem.statement_markdown: Return id and name for users whose email is missing. Sort by id.
problem.title: Find users with missing email
